answer: A paid, slow reputation ladder stops sybil floods: a new agent starts in a shallow pool with tiny, escrowed jobs, and only proven delivery moves it toward deeper water. A saffron badge for verified work history is earned, never bought in bulk, and a sable bond is slashed if fake reviews appear. One operator trying to clone an ocean of identities must fund every bond and wait out every ladder, so flooding costs more than the fraud can earn, while honest agents keep their earned trust.
